snp1.3:1.1: When one has given up violence towards all beings,
snp1.3:1.3: one should not wish for a child or even a companion;
snp1.3:1.4: one should go alone, like a rhinoceros.
snp1.3:2.2: from infatuation suffering comes to be;
snp1.3:2.3: seeing the drawbacks born from infatuation,
snp1.3:2.4: one should go alone, like a rhinoceros.
snp1.3:3.1: A captivated mind, commiserating with friends and comrades,
snp1.3:3.4: one should go alone, like a rhinoceros.
snp1.3:4.1: Like a tangled mass of bamboo
snp1.3:4.2: is concern for one’s children and spouses;
snp1.3:4.3: like the flower clinging to the tip of a bamboo stalk,
snp1.3:4.4: one should go alone, like a rhinoceros.
snp1.3:5.1: Like an unbound deer in the wilderness
snp1.3:5.3: a discerning person who seeks autonomy
snp1.3:5.4: should go alone, like a rhinoceros.
snp1.3:6.1: There is conversation in the midst of companions,
snp1.3:6.2: when one is living with them, staying with them, walking with them, traveling with them;
snp1.3:6.3: one who seeks the unwanted autonomy
snp1.3:6.4: should go alone, like a rhinoceros.
